description: Create internationalization (i18n) support, documentation suite (README, deployment guide, user manual, checklists), CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions), Docker development environment, sample data, and Supabase RLS policies/SQL migrations. This completes the platform deliverables.
steps: Create src/i18n/ directory with: request.ts (next-intl server config), config.ts (supported locales: ko, en, ja, zh), routing.ts (locale routing setup)
Create src/messages/ko.json - Korean translations for all UI strings (navigation, dashboard labels, form fields, buttons, status values, error messages)
Create src/messages/en.json - English translations
Create src/messages/ja.json - Japanese translations (key navigation and dashboard labels)
Create src/messages/zh.json - Chinese translations (key navigation and dashboard labels)

Create supabase/migrations/0002_rls_policies.sql - Row Level Security policies: companies (users can only access their own company), emission_records (filtered by company_id, role-based write access), audit_logs (read-only for all, no delete/update), emission_factors (read for all, write for admin only), reports (company-scoped), suppliers (company-scoped). Enable RLS on all tables

Create supabase/seed.sql - Sample data for a Korean manufacturing company: company profile, 2 sites, 4 facilities, emission sources (boilers, vehicles, electricity, refrigerants), 12 months of emission records across all scopes, sample emission factors (Korea MOE 2023), sample users with different roles, sample workflow instances, sample targets

Create .github/workflows/ci.yml - GitHub Actions CI pipeline: trigger on push/PR to main, jobs: lint (eslint), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (vitest run), build (next build), with Node.js 22, pnpm caching, artifact upload for build output
Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml - Vercel deployment workflow: trigger on push to main, deploy to Vercel using vercel CLI, environment variables from secrets

Create Dockerfile - Multi-stage build: Stage 1 (deps) install with pnpm, Stage 2 (build) run next build, Stage 3 (runner) minimal production image with standalone output. Also create docker-compose.yml with services: app (Next.js), db (PostgreSQL 15), supabase-studio (for local dev)
Create docker-compose.yml - Development environment with PostgreSQL, app service, and volume mounts

Create docs/README.md - Comprehensive README: project overview, architecture diagram (ASCII), tech stack, features list, getting started guide, environment variables table, development commands, deployment instructions, contributing guidelines, license

Create docs/deployment-guide.md - Step-by-step Vercel deployment: prerequisites, Supabase project setup, environment variables configuration, domain setup, CI/CD pipeline explanation, monitoring setup

Create docs/user-manual.md - End-user documentation: login, dashboard overview, adding emission records, managing emission factors, generating reports, supplier portal usage, workflow approval process
Create docs/admin-manual.md - Administrator guide: user management, role assignment, organization setup, emission factor version management, system configuration, backup procedures
Create docs/api-documentation.md - API reference: all endpoints with request/response examples, authentication, pagination, filtering, error codes, rate limits, webhook configuration

Create docs/iso14064-checklist.md - ISO 14064 third-party verification readiness checklist: organizational boundaries, operational boundaries, quantification methodology, data management, uncertainty assessment, reporting, documentation requirements. Map each requirement to the platform feature that addresses it

Create docs/ghg-protocol-checklist.md - GHG Protocol conformance checklist: relevance, completeness, consistency, transparency, accuracy. Cover Corporate Standard, Scope 2 Guidance, and Corporate Value Chain Standard requirements
Create docs/architecture.md - System architecture: component diagram, data flow, security model, multi-tenancy approach, calculation engine design, MRV pipeline, integration points

Create docs/database-schema.md - Database documentation: ERD description (text-based), table descriptions, relationship explanations, indexing strategy, partitioning approach for large emission_records table
Ensure pnpm build passes with all i18n and new files in place
acceptance_criteria: All 4 language translation files contain consistent keys covering at minimum: navigation items, dashboard labels, common actions (save, cancel, delete, submit, approve, reject)
Supabase RLS SQL is valid PostgreSQL with proper policy definitions
Sample data SQL inserts valid records that reference each other correctly via UUIDs
GitHub Actions CI workflow is valid YAML that would run on push/PR
Dockerfile builds a valid multi-stage image definition
README.md is comprehensive (over 200 lines) covering all major aspects of the project
ISO 14064 checklist maps standard requirements to platform features
GHG Protocol checklist covers all three standards (Corporate, Scope 2, Value Chain)
pnpm build succeeds with all additions
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm successful compilation with i18n setup
